school: 实学（技术百科全书派·经世致用传统的工艺集大成者）
historical_significance: 宋应星（1587-约1666），明末科学家、技术思想家，《天工开物》（1637）作者——中国乃至世界第一部系统记录农业与手工业全产业链生产技术的百科全书。江西奉新人，万历举人，五试进士不第，遂绝科举之念，转而以'此书于功名进取毫不相关'的自白写下产业之学：任江西分宜县教谕期间遍访田间与作坊，把稻麦种植、蚕桑缫丝、陶瓷烧造、冶铸、造纸、榨油、舟车、兵器、朱墨、曲蘖等一百三十余项生产经验配以一百二十三幅工图，写成'贵五谷而贱金玉'的技术总账。他的独特处在于方法论：以'天工'（自然力）与'开物'（人工开发）的辩证定义技术——'天覆地载，物数号万，而事亦因之，曲成而不遗'；坚持'采访'而非抄书，'数字'而非修辞，为每道工序记录物料配比、火候、损耗与工价；在《论气》《谈天》《野议》中把同样的实证精神推向声学、宇宙论与时政批判。明亡后隐居不仕，其书反因记录了帝国的生产能力而流传——他是把'格物'从道德玄谈改写为产业工程的第一人
historical_significance_en: Song Yingxing (1587-c.1666), late-Ming scientist and technological thinker, author of Tiangong Kaiwu (The Exploitation of the Works of Nature, 1637) — the first encyclopedia in China, and among the first in the world, to systematically document the entire production chains of agriculture and handicraft industry. A native of Fengxin, Jiangxi, a provincial juren who failed the metropolitan examination five times, he gave up on official rank — declaring 'this book has nothing to do with the pursuit of fame' — and turned to the learning of industry: while serving as a school instructor in Fenyi he visited the fields and the workshops, recording more than 130 production techniques — grain cultivation, sericulture and silk reeling, porcelain firing, metallurgy, papermaking, oil pressing, shipbuilding, weaponry, pigment and yeast — each furnished with diagrams (123 in all) in a grand account that 'honours the five grains and deems gold and jade cheap'. His distinctiveness is methodological: he defined technology through the dialectic of 'works of Heaven' (natural forces) and 'the opening of things' (human development); he insisted on field interview rather than book-copying, on numbers rather than rhetoric, recording for each process the material ratios, firing temperatures, losses and labour costs; and in the Essays on Qi, on Heaven and on the Times he pushed the same empirical spirit into acoustics, cosmology and political critique. After the fall of the Ming he lived in retirement; his book survived precisely because it recorded the productive capacity of an empire — the first man to rewrite 'the investigation of things' from moral speculation into industrial engineering
unique_thinking: 以'天工开物'界定技术（自然力与人工的辩证合作）；以田野采访替代文献转抄的知识生产方式；以数字、配比、工价、损耗取代修辞描述；'贵五谷而贱金玉'的价值排序（民生实用高于贵重稀缺）；把格物之学从科举玄谈改写为产业总账的工程认识论
unique_thinking_en: defining technology as the dialectical cooperation of natural forces ('works of Heaven') and human development ('the opening of things'); knowledge production by field investigation in place of textual transmission; numbers, ratios, costs and losses in place of rhetorical description; the value ordering 'honour the five grains, deem gold and jade cheap' (livelihood utility above precious scarcity); an engineering epistemology that rewrote the investigation of things from examination-hall speculation into the grand account of industry
civilization_zh: 中华文明（明末江南与江西农耕手工业文明圈）
civilization_en: Chinese civilization (the late-Ming agrarian-handicraft sphere of Jiangnan and Jiangxi)
key_works: 《天工开物》（1637）——农工全产业链技术百科，十八卷配百廿三图，'中国十七世纪的工艺百科全书'
《野议》——时政论集：以产业与民生的实证数据论粮政、盐政、兵政之弊
《论气》《谈天》——自然哲学论集：声的发生与传播、日食月食与'气'的宇宙论解释
《思怜诗》——自编诗集：记录其价值立场与'伤哉贫也'的士人处境
《画音归正》——文字声韵之作（佚），显示其对声音分析的持续兴趣
key_concepts: 天工开物 (The Works of Heaven and the Exploitation of Things)
贵五谷而贱金玉 (Honour the Grains, Deem Gold and Jade Cheap)
数字记账 (Numerical Bookkeeping of Craft)
物数号万 (The Myriad Numbering of Things)
功名毫不相关 (Nothing to Do with Official Fame)
火候物性 (Heat-Timing and Material Nature)
生人未必巧，熟者能巧 (Skill from Practice, Not Birth)
格物工程化 (Engineering the Investigation of Things)
cross_references: M-SYX-001（天工开物法——全部十模式的元方法论：自然力与人工的分工总纲）
M-SYX-003（采访核账法——遍访作坊田间、以数字核验传闻的知识生产方式）
M-SYX-005（链条互养法——谷、丝、陶、冶各业互为原料与市场的产业链思维）
M-SYX-007（图纸传艺法——百廿三幅工图把口传手艺变成可复制文件）
M-SYX-010（格物改写法——把科举格物改写为产业工程的认识论总纲）
M-ZSS-001（朱舜水：实理实学法——平行：同为明末实学，一在本土写产业总账，一在异邦行工程实学；皆以'能行'为知识判准）
M-HZX-001（黄宗羲：同样经历明亡的知识人——黄宗羲写制度批判，宋应星写生产总账：对帝国溃败的两种实证回答）
M-ZHH-001（郭守敬/张衡一系实测传统：以仪器与数据立论的先例——宋应星把这条实测线从天文延伸到作坊）

modes.name_en: The Method of Heaven-Work and Thing-Opening (Tiangong Kaiwu)
modes.domain_zh: 技术哲学与方法论总纲/以'天工'与'开物'的辩证界定一切技术
modes.domain_en: Philosophy of technology and master methodology
modes.definition_zh: 技术哲学与方法论总纲/以'天工'与'开物'的辩证界定一切技术：'天工'是自然力自运其功——水磨自转、稻自生长、炉火自炼；'开物'是人力对自然力的开发与导引——凿渠导水、育种改良、控温控料；技术的本质既非征服自然亦非模仿自然，而是'曲成而不遗'的协同——人工嵌在自然力的缝隙里，把万物之'数'（物性规律）转化为可用之'事'；此法把'技术'从匠人的秘传口诀提升为人与自然分工协作的系统设计
modes.definition_en: Philosophy of technology and master methodology / defining all technology through the dialectic of 'works of Heaven' and 'the opening of things': the works of Heaven are nature's self-operating powers — the water-wheel turns of itself, rice grows of itself, the furnace fire smelts of itself; the opening of things is human guidance of those powers — cutting channels to direct water, breeding to improve seed, controlling heat and material; technology is neither conquering nature nor imitating it but cooperation 'bringing all to completion without omission' — human art fits itself into the seams of natural force, converting the 'numbers' of things (their regularities) into usable 'affairs'; this method raises technology from the craftsman's secret formula to a systems design of the division of labour between man and nature
modes.key_quote_zh: 天覆地载，物数号万，而事亦因之，曲成而不遗——岂人力之所为哉？
modes.key_quote_en: 'Heaven covers, earth carries; things are numbered by the myriad, and affairs arise accordingly, brought to completion without omission — how could this be the work of human force alone?'
process_zh: 盘点自然力：列出可用自运其功的'天工'——水力、火力、物性、天时——不做自然已在做的事
找人力缝隙：在自然力自运的环节之间定位必须人工介入的接口——下种、引水、控温、配比
设计协同工序：把天工与人工编排成一条流水线，让自然力承担能耗大头、人力承担控制点
验证总账：以产出成品与消耗账目结算整条链——天工是否省了人力，人工是否控住了品质
process_en: Inventory natural forces: list the self-operating 'works of Heaven' available — water, fire, material properties, season — never doing what nature does unaided
Locate the human seams: identify the interfaces where human intervention is required between nature's self-running stages — sowing, channelling, temperature, proportions
Design the cooperative sequence: arrange Heaven's work and man's work into one production line, letting natural forces carry the bulk of energy expenditure and human hands hold the control points
Settle the account: close the whole chain against output and consumption — did Heaven's work save labour, did man's work hold the quality?
representative_cases_zh: 写《乃粒》篇先记稻的物性与天时，再记人的育秧、插秧、灌溉——把'种稻'写成天工与人工的接力
写《乃服》篇记录缫丝：蚕自吐丝为天工，煮茧、缫丝、织造为人开物——每一环节标注'自然做工几成、人工做工几成'
写《作咸》篇论盐：海水自咸、日光自晒为天工，开滩、纳卤、收盐为人开物
序言自陈著述原则：'贵五谷而贱金玉'——以天工养人的排序统摄全书十八卷的编排
representative_cases_en: In the chapter on grains he records first the nature of rice and the seasons of Heaven, then man's sowing, transplanting and irrigation — writing rice-growing as a relay between Heaven's work and man's

In the chapter on clothing he records silk reeling: the silkworm spins of itself (Heaven), the boiling, reeling and weaving are man's opening of things — each stage marked with how much is done by nature and how much by art
In the chapter on salt: the sea is briny and the sun evaporates of itself (Heaven); opening the flats, taking the brine and gathering the crystals are man's part

In the preface he states the ordering principle — 'honour the five grains, deem gold and jade cheap' — letting the ranking of nature's livelihood-giving work govern the arrangement of all eighteen chapters
modern_applications_zh: 把技术系统拆成'自然力承担层'与'人工控制层'再设计——现代流程工程的'免费能源优先'原则
绿色制造与可再生能源集成：让自然力承担能耗、人工聚焦控制，正是'天工开物'的当代版
人机协同设计：机器做重复功、人做判断——与天工/开物分工同构
技术评估不问'是否先进'而问'天工人力配置是否最省'——效率的协同定义
modern_applications_en: Decompose a technology system into a 'natural-force layer' and a 'human-control layer' and redesign — the modern process-engineering principle of free-energy first
Green manufacturing and renewables integration: letting natural forces carry energy while human control focuses — the contemporary Tiangong Kaiwu
Human-machine collaboration: machines do the repetitive, humans the judgment — isomorphic to the Heaven/man division
Evaluate technology not by 'is it advanced' but by 'is the Heaven-work/man-work allocation the least costly' — an ecological definition of efficiency
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
贾思勰（先例：《齐民要术》同样系统记录农艺，但以文献辑录为主，宋应星以现场采访与工图立新）
徐光启（平行：同译《农政全书》重农政，宋应星重工艺——一个重制度、一个重工序，互补成明末实学双璧）
李比希（跨文明平行：十九世纪以化学定律定义农业生产，同样把自然规律转化为工艺参数）

modes.name_en: The Method of Honouring Grain over Jade
modes.domain_zh: 价值排序方法论/以'贵五谷而贱金玉'重排知识记录的优先级
modes.definition_zh: 价值排序方法论/以'贵五谷而贱金玉'重排知识记录的优先级：值得写、值得学、值得传的学问，按其对养民活人的实际贡献排序而非按其稀缺与贵重排序——玉无益于饥、金无疗于寒，故珠玉在《天工开物》中被压到卷末，而稻麦、蚕桑、 salt 铁居前；此法把'价值'从市场价格改写为生命效用，为知识与技术的记录立下民生判准：能养人者为贵，能炫人者为贱
modes.definition_en: Value-ordering methodology / re-ranking the priorities of recorded knowledge by 'honouring the five grains and deeming gold and jade cheap': the learning worth writing, studying and transmitting is ranked by its actual contribution to feeding and sustaining people, not by its scarcity or price — jade does not feed the hungry, gold does not warm the cold, so pearls and jade are pushed to the end of the Tiangong Kaiwu while grain, silk, salt and iron come first; the method rewrites 'value' from market price into life-utility, establishing a livelihood criterion for what knowledge deserves record: that which nourishes is precious, that which dazzles is cheap
modes.key_quote_zh: 卷分前后，乃贵五谷而贱金玉之义
modes.key_quote_en: 'The order of the chapters, front and back, embodies the meaning of honouring the five grains and deeming gold and jade cheap.'
process_zh: 列出待排序的全部对象：产品、技术、知识、投资标的——不作道德判断，只列清单
引入生命效用判准：逐项问'断供此物，多少人活不下去'——以依赖人数与紧迫度打分
重排资源流向：按判准把记录篇幅、资金、人力、政策权重重新排序——刚需者居前，奢侈品居末
定期复核：物价与稀缺会变，生命效用不会——用判准每年重审一次排序，抵制市场价值的侵蚀
process_en: List everything to be ranked — products, techniques, knowledge, investments — without moral judgment, a plain inventory
Apply the life-utility criterion: ask of each 'if this were cut off, how many people could not live' — score by dependence and urgency
Re-rank resource flows: by the criterion reorder record-space, capital, manpower and policy weight — necessities first, luxuries last
Re-audit periodically: prices and scarcity shift, life-utility does not — re-apply the criterion yearly and resist erosion by market value
representative_cases_zh: 《天工开物》十八卷的排序本身：乃粒（粮食）居首，乃服（衣）次之，彰施（染色）、粹精（粮食加工）居中，珠玉居末——一部书的目录就是一张价值宣言
记录珍珠采集时详写采珠人的生命危险与珠价的关系，反衬'贵物贱人'之弊——用数字暴露价值错位
写五金篇先铁后金：铁可铸犁可铸兵，金只可饰——以用途的多寡而非 rarity 定先后
在《野议》中以同样判准论时政：漕粮、盐政居前，祥瑞、珍玩斥为'无益之费'
representative_cases_en: The ordering of the Tiangong Kaiwu's eighteen chapters itself: grains first, clothing second, dyeing and grain-processing in the middle, pearls and jade last — a book's table of contents as a value declaration
In recording pearl-diving he details the divers' mortal danger against the price of pearls, exposing the perversity of 'valuing things, cheapening lives' with numbers
In the chapter on metals, iron before gold: iron casts ploughs and weapons, gold only ornaments — order fixed by breadth of use, not rarity
In the Essays on the Times he judges policy by the same criterion: grain transport and salt administration first; auspicious omens and curios condemned as 'profitless expense'
modern_applications_zh: 产品线排序以'断供影响面'而非毛利定优先级——民生型企业的价值排序法
基础设施投资优先级：水、粮、能源、医疗居前，装饰性资产居末
个人时间管理：把'贵五谷'用于日程——养活身体健康与生计的事项优先于炫技性任务
知识库建设先录'活下去需要什么'再录'显得高级什么'——内容价值的生命效用判准
modern_applications_en: Rank product lines by blast-radius of supply loss, not gross margin — the livelihood-enterprise value ordering
Infrastructure investment priority: water, food, energy, health before decorative assets
Personal time management: apply 'honour the grain' to the calendar — what sustains health and livelihood outranks what shows off skill
Build knowledge bases by recording 'what keeps us alive' before 'what looks sophisticated' — a life-utility criterion for content value
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
管仲（先例：'仓廪实而知礼节'——同样以粮食为价值序列之首，但用于治国论，宋应星用于知识论）
贾思勰（平行：《齐民要术》自序'要在安民，富而教之'——同为重农知识排序）
阿马蒂亚·森（跨文明平行：以可行能力而非收入定义发展——把'价值'从市场价格改写为生命效用）

modes.name_en: The Method of Field Inquiry and Verified Accounts
modes.domain_zh: 知识生产方法论/以'采访'（田野现场核问）替代文献转抄
modes.definition_zh: 知识生产方法论/以'采访'（田野现场核问）替代文献转抄：技术知识不从书本来，从田间、作坊、窑场、冶坊的匠人处来——向最有经验的从业者当面提问，观察实际操作，并把听来的说法与账目数字（物料配比、损耗、工价、产量）相互核验；传闻与数字不符者存疑，数字与成品不符者弃用；此法把'实证'落到两条腿上——一手观察与一手账目，是十七世纪的知识生产质量控制流程
modes.definition_en: Knowledge-production methodology / replacing textual transmission with field inquiry: technical knowledge comes not from books but from the craftsmen of fields, workshops, kilns and foundries — question the most experienced practitioners face to face, watch the actual operations, and cross-check what is heard against account-book numbers (material ratios, losses, wages, yields); what contradicts the numbers stays doubtful, what the numbers contradict is discarded; the method grounds empiricism on two legs — first-hand observation and first-hand accounts — a seventeenth-century quality-control process for knowledge production
modes.key_quote_zh: 世有聪明博物者，稠人推焉——乃枣梨之花未赏，而臆度楚萍；釜鬵之范鲜经，而侈谈莒鼎
modes.key_quote_en: 'Men of cleverness are praised by crowds as knowers of things — yet having never seen the jujube and pear blossom they conjecture the tripod of Chu; having rarely handled a casting mould they discourse loftily on the ding of Ju.'
process_zh: 锁定一线源：为每个知识条目找到真正动手的人——老农、窑工、炉头、船匠——而非读过书的人
现场提问与观察：当面问操作细节并旁观实际做一遍——记录动作顺序、手感判据与例外处理
数字核账：把口述转为数字——配比、温度、损耗率、工价、产量——口说不算数，账对得上才算
交叉复核与存疑：多个来源相互印证；对不上者明确标注'存疑'而不掩盖——留待下次采访再验
process_en: Lock onto the front line: for each item of knowledge find the person whose hands actually do it — the old farmer, kiln hand, furnace master, shipwright — not one who has merely read
Ask and observe on site: question the details face to face and watch the operation performed — recording the order of moves, the feel-based judgments, the exception handling
Verify against numbers: convert speech into figures — ratios, temperatures, loss rates, wages, yields — words alone count for nothing; the account must reconcile
Cross-check and mark doubt: let multiple sources corroborate; whatever fails to reconcile is explicitly marked 'doubtful', not papered over — left for the next inquiry
representative_cases_zh: 写《乃粒》：不抄《齐民要术》成文，而记分宜当地稻种的早中晚之分、浸种时日与实际亩产——数字来自农户口述
写《陶埏》：亲至窑场记录瓷器烧造的七十二道工序与窑位温差——'共计一坯之力，过手七十二，方克成器'的工序账
写《冶铸》：访冶坊记录合金配比与炉温火候，凡匠人说法与成品质量对不上处标'未详'
序言批评臆度者：'枣梨之花未赏而臆度楚萍'——把书斋转抄者作为方法上的反面人物立此存照
representative_cases_en: In the grains chapter he does not copy the Qimin Yaoshu but records the local Fenyi rice varieties' early/mid/late split, seed-soaking days and actual per-mu yields — figures from farmers' mouths

In the pottery chapter he visits kilns to record the seventy-two operations of porcelain firing and the temperature gradient of kiln positions — the process account 'one vessel passes through seventy-two hands before it is done'
In the casting chapter he interviews foundries on alloy ratios and furnace heat, marking 'not yet clear' wherever a craftsman's claim failed against the finished piece
In the preface he pillories the conjecturers — 'never having seen jujube blossom they speculate on the tripod of Chu' — setting the library transcriber as the method's反面 figure
modern_applications_zh: 用户研究：访谈一线用户并以其行为数据核验说法，而非采信二手报告
尽职调查：把口头承诺转成可核对的账目数字再决策——'口说不算数，账对得上才算'
行业知识图谱构建：由从业者口述+操作录像+工单数据三源交叉，取代文献综述
技术尽调中的'现场眼'：进车间看实际操作并与物耗单据对账
modern_applications_en: User research: interview frontline users and verify claims against their behavioural data, not second-hand reports
Due diligence: convert verbal promises into checkable account figures before deciding — words alone count for nothing; the account must reconcile
Building industry knowledge graphs: practitioner interviews + operation video + ticket data cross-checked, replacing literature reviews
The 'site eye' in technical diligence: walk the shop floor, watch the operation, reconcile against material-consumption records
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
司马迁（先例：'读万卷书行万里路'式的现场采录，但用于历史，宋应星用于工艺）
李时珍（平行：同走'访采'路线——《本草纲目》遍问药农樵夫，一医一工，同法异域）
泰勒（跨文明平行：科学管理以秒表实测工序——同样把口传手艺转成可核验数字，但缺对匠人经验的尊重）

modes.name_en: The Method of Heat-Timing and Material Nature
modes.domain_zh: 工艺参数化方法论/把匠人手上的'火候'与物料的'物性'转成可传授的参数体系
modes.definition_zh: 工艺参数化方法论/把匠人手上的'火候'与物料的'物性'转成可传授的参数体系：每种材料有其'性'（遇火如何、遇水如何、遇酸如何），每道工序有其'候'（几分火、几沉几浮、几蒸几晒）——识别物性是选料的前提，掌握火候是操作的核心；此法的要点是把手感经验'转写'为条件-响应规则：'若见此状，则施此候'——使不依赖个别天才匠人的稳定质量控制成为可能
modes.definition_en: Process-control methodology / converting the craftsman's felt 'timing of heat' and the material's 'nature' into a teachable parameter system: every material has its nature (how it answers fire, water, acid), every process its timing (degree of flame, how many sinks and floats, steams and dryings) — recognising material nature is the premise of selection, mastering heat-timing is the core of operation; the method's point is transcribing felt experience into condition-response rules — 'upon seeing this state, apply this timing' — making quality control that depends on no single gifted craftsman possible
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡火候之验，有合于古而异于今者……观其色，听其声，察其变
modes.key_quote_en: 'The verification of heat-timing may accord with the ancients yet differ today… observe the colour, listen to the sound, watch the change.' (on reading furnace and bath conditions from signs)
process_zh: 建立物性档案：对每类物料记录其在水、火、酸、力之下的响应——沉淀、变色、开裂、熔融——成'性'的清单
显影手感判据：请老匠人说出'看什么、听什么、摸什么'——把不可言传的手感转成可观察的征兆清单
写成条件-响应规则：'若征兆X出现，则实施操作Y，持续Z时'——每条规则附失败案例与判别要点
以废品率验证规则：新匠人按规则操作，废品率若接近老师傅则转写成功；未达则回头补征兆清单
process_en: Build a nature dossier: for each material class record its responses to water, fire, acid and force — settling, discolouring, cracking, melting — an inventory of 'natures'
Develop the felt criteria: ask the veteran craftsman what he watches, hears and touches — convert ineffable feel into an observable omen list
Write condition-response rules: 'when omen X appears, perform operation Y for duration Z' — each rule annotated with failure cases and discrimination points
Validate by reject rate: have novices work by the rules; if their reject rate approaches the master's the transcription succeeded; if not, return and enrich the omen list
representative_cases_zh: 记录灰水的配比与淘洗次数：'灰面多则纸脆，淘洗过则浆流'——以配比与次数替代'适量'
写烧造：窑位（上中下）、火色（红光如豆为几成火）、观火孔判断法——把窑工的观火经验写成可教条目
写榨油：炒籽火候'以香起为度'、蒸粉时间与出油率的对应——把'凭香气'转成时间与状态双指标
写冶铸：铸型预热的必要性、铁水温度与浇注速度的关系——凡'急则裂、缓则凝'皆录为规则
representative_cases_en: Recording lime-water ratios and washing counts: 'too much lime makes paper brittle, over-washing thins the pulp' — ratios and counts in place of 'as appropriate'
On firing: kiln position (upper, middle, lower), flame colour ('bean-red' as a degree of heat), the peephole judgment — kiln masters' fire-reading written into teachable entries
On oil pressing: the roast's 'stop when fragrance rises', and steaming time mapped to oil yield — 'by fragrance' converted into paired time-and-state indicators
On casting: the necessity of pre-heating the mould, molten-iron temperature against pour speed — every 'too fast cracks, too slow freezes' recorded as a rule
modern_applications_zh: 把老师傅的直觉写成故障树与检查表——SOP 编制的古典范式
工艺数字化前必须先做'参数转写'：无手感显影，传感器数据无从标注
新人培训体系：以条件-响应规则+废品率验证替代多年学徒期
AI 质检的标注学：先向老质检员采集'看什么'的征兆清单，再训模型
modern_applications_en: Write the veteran's intuition into fault trees and checklists — the classical paradigm of SOP authoring
Parameter transcription must precede process digitalisation: without developing the felt criteria, sensor data has nothing to be labelled against
Novice training systems: condition-response rules validated by reject rate in place of years of apprenticeship
Labelling methodology for AI quality inspection: harvest the veteran inspector's 'what to watch' omen list before training the model
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
《考工记》作者（先例：'天有时，地有气，材有美，工有巧'——材料-工艺四要素论的源头，宋应星把它参数化）
沈括（平行：《梦溪笔谈》记录活字、石油等工艺现象，同为笔记体工艺观察）
丰田佐吉（跨文明平行：把手感与机器参数结合实现自动织机——手感显影的工程化后裔）

modes.domain_zh: 产业链方法论/把产业写成互为原料、互为市场的链条而非孤立的行业清单
modes.definition_zh: 产业链方法论/把产业写成互为原料、互为市场的链条而非孤立的行业清单：粮食链条的糠秕喂猪、猪粪肥田，纸坊的竹料来自竹山、纸的包装又进米市，冶铁的炭来自林场、铁器回到农事——每个环节的废弃物是下环节的原料，每个行业的需求是上环节的市场；此法的要点是沿着'物'的走向而非'业'的目录做记录与设计，由此暴露单行业视角看不见的依赖、瓶颈与放大效应
modes.definition_en: Industrial-systems methodology / writing industry as chains that feed each other as material and market, not isolated trade catalogues: the grain chain's chaff feeds pigs, pig manure fertilises fields; the paper mill's bamboo comes from bamboo hills and its wrapping enters the rice market; iron's charcoal comes from forests and iron tools return to farming — each stage's waste is the next stage's raw material, each trade's demand the upstream's market; the method's point is recording and designing along the path of the thing, not the catalogue of trades, thereby exposing dependencies, bottlenecks and amplification effects invisible to the single-industry view
modes.key_quote_zh: 生人不能久生而五谷生之，五谷不能自生而生人生之——土脉历时代而异，种性随水土而分
modes.key_quote_en: 'Man cannot sustain himself, yet the five grains sustain him; the grains cannot grow of themselves, yet men grow them… soil differs across ages, seed-nature divides with water and land.'
process_zh: 选一个'物'作线索：稻、丝、铁、纸——沿着它的完整生命周期走：从原料到成品到废料
画出上下游：每环节记录其原料从何来、产品往何去、废料被谁接走——不问行业归属，只问物流向
标出依存与瓶颈：找出一处断供会冻住整条链的节点（炭窑、蚕种、竹山）——这些是系统的真实要害
以链条设计改良：优化不落在单点而在耦合处——让 A 的废料恰好是 B 的原料，让 B 的需求稳定 A 的开工
process_en: Pick one thing as the thread: rice, silk, iron, paper — walk its full life cycle from raw material to product to waste
Draw the up- and downstream: for each stage record where material comes from, product goes, and who takes the waste — ask not the trade it belongs to but the flow of the thing
Mark dependencies and bottlenecks: find the nodes whose supply failure would freeze the whole chain (charcoal kilns, silkworm eggs, bamboo hills) — the system's true vitals
Improve at the couplings: optimise not single points but junctions — let A's waste be exactly B's material, and B's demand steady A's operation
representative_cases_zh: 写《乃粒》与《彰施》的呼应：种稻的糠秕与稻草进入饲料与纸料——粮食链与纺织链经废料衔接
写《杀青》（造纸）：竹料、楮皮来自山场，纸成后进入市集包装——从竹山到书坊写成一条完整链
写《冶铸》：木炭来自林场烧制、铁矿与炭窑的地理配合、铁器成品回到农具市场——材料链的地理学
写《作咸》与《甘嗜》：盐与糖的产区、运输线路与消费市场——把调味品也放进民生物流网
representative_cases_en: In the grains and dyeing chapters in echo: rice chaff and straw enter feed and paper stock — the grain chain and the textile chain joined through waste
In the papermaking chapter: bamboo and paper-mulberry bark from the hills, finished paper entering market packaging — one complete chain from bamboo grove to bookshop
In the casting chapter: charcoal from forest kilns, the geographic pairing of ore and kiln, finished iron returning to the farm-tool market — a geography of the material chain
In the salt and sugar chapters: production zones, transport routes and consumer markets — putting even condiments into the livelihood logistics web
modern_applications_zh: 供应链地图绘制：沿物料流向而非公司架构梳理——暴露单点依赖与隐性瓶颈
循环经济设计：把 A 流程废料做成 B 流程原料——耦合点的商业价值评估
区域产业规划：先画完整产业链再定招商目录——防止只招龙头不配套
风险审计：对链条要害节点（单源供应商、单一产区）做断供演练
modern_applications_en: Supply-chain mapping by material flow, not org chart — exposing single-point dependencies and hidden bottlenecks
Circular-economy design: converting process A's waste into process B's material — valuing the coupling points commercially
Regional industrial planning: draw the whole chain before drafting the investment catalogue — avoid landing anchors without the ecosystem
Risk audit: run supply-failure drills on the chain's vital nodes (single-source suppliers, single regions)
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
管仲（先例：'官山海'以盐铁为链首的产业统筹——但为财政取用，宋应星为民生记录）
徐光启（平行：《农政全书》的水利-荒政链条，同为跨行业民生系统思维）
赫希曼（跨文明平行：'不平衡增长'与前后向联锁效应——产业链耦合的理论化后裔）

modes.name_en: The Method of Refusing Conjecture and Marking Doubt
modes.domain_zh: 知识诚实方法论/对未经亲验的知识坚持两种处理
modes.definition_zh: 知识诚实方法论/对未经亲验的知识坚持两种处理：能核验的核验，不能核验的标'存疑'而不以文饰填补——宋应星对传说工艺（如传说中的异宝）不因流传已久而采信，对亲见而未能解释的现象（如声的传播、日食之理）也不因不能解释而删除；记录分三层：确证、存疑、谬误订正；此法把'不知道'制度化——知之为知之、不知为存疑、误者订正之，是知识库自我纠错的原始机制
modes.definition_en: Epistemic-honesty methodology / insisting on two treatments for unverified knowledge: verify what can be verified, mark 'doubtful' what cannot — never fill gaps with literary decoration; Song Yingxing would not accept transmitted lore of marvellous treasures merely because it was old, nor delete phenomena he had seen but could not explain (the propagation of sound, the mechanism of eclipses); records fall into three layers: confirmed, doubtful, and corrected errors; the method institutionalises 'not knowing' — know as known, doubt as doubtful, correct the mistaken — the primitive self-correcting mechanism of a knowledge base
modes.key_quote_zh: 亦幸生同世，得见其所见——不敢妄加雌黄
modes.key_quote_en: 'Fortunate to live in the same age and see what they saw — I dare not carelessly paint over it.' (on refusing to embellish what he had not verified)
process_zh: 分层录入：新知识进库时即标三色——亲验确证/他人证言待核/传闻无法核验
禁止文饰填充：存疑处只写'未详'并注明问过的对象与日期——不许用推理和修辞补白
主动订正旧误：发现自己先前或通行记载有误，专设'订正'条目公开更正——错误不可静默消失
定期重验存疑项：每有条件（新工具、新通路）先重验存疑清单——存疑是待办而非终点
process_en: Enter in layers: as new knowledge enters the base, mark three colours — self-verified, testimony pending, untestable rumour
Forbid decorative filling: doubtful entries read only 'not yet clear' with the source and date questioned — no padding with inference or rhetoric
Correct old errors actively: when one's own prior record or common tradition proves wrong, open a dedicated 'correction' entry — errors may not vanish silently
Re-verify the doubtful on schedule: whenever conditions improve (new tools, new channels), the doubtful list is re-tested first — doubt is a to-do, not an endpoint
representative_cases_zh: 对古籍所载'神物'与'异宝'一律不采信入正文，只在按语注明'此传闻也，未之见'——传闻与实录分栏
写《论气》论声：亲见乐器与回声现象，理未通透则直言'其所以然，未之尽晓'——保留问题而非硬给答案
订正旧说：对'虎珀拾芥'等通行说法以亲试结果为准——试之不验者明言不验
《天工开物》凡匠人两派说法相异处并列两说并注'两存之'——不以作者偏好裁断
representative_cases_en: Lore of 'marvellous objects' from old books is never admitted to the main text, only noted in commentary as 'this is hearsay, untested' — hearsay and record kept in separate columns

In the Essays on Qi on sound: phenomena of instruments and echoes seen first-hand, yet where the principle is not clear he writes plainly 'its why I do not fully understand' — keeping the question rather than forcing an answer
Correcting tradition: claims like amber attracting mustard are settled by his own trials — where the trial fails he says so
Where two schools of craftsmen disagree, the Tiangong Kaiwu sets both versions side by side annotated 'both retained' — never settled by authorial preference
modern_applications_zh: 数据标注规范：无证据标签必须标'uncertain'而非猜测补齐——不确定性的显式管理
研究报告的'存疑清单'制度：把'不知道'写成待办而非删除——知识库的自我纠错
百科与知识图谱的勘误机制：公开更正条目，错误可追溯不可静默
决策纪要的三层置信标记：已验证/待验证/传闻——防止传闻升格为决策依据
modern_applications_en: Data-labelling standards: labels without evidence are marked 'uncertain' rather than guessed — explicit management of uncertainty
The 'doubt list' in research reports: 'not knowing' written as a to-do, not deleted — a knowledge base's self-correction
Errata mechanisms for wikis and knowledge graphs: public correction entries; errors traceable, never silent
Three-tier confidence marks in decision minutes: verified / pending / hearsay — keeping rumour from becoming a basis for decisions
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
孔子（先例：'知之为知之，不知为不知'——知识诚实的伦理源头，宋应星把它做成记录规程）
沈括（平行：《梦溪笔谈》'存中'式的存疑记录，同为笔记体知识诚实）
费米（跨文明平行：坦承'尚未理解'的物理问题清单——把'不知道'制度化驱动研究）

modes.name_en: The Method of Transmitting Craft by Drawing
modes.domain_zh: 知识工程方法论/以图为主、以文为辅把口传手艺变成可复制的文件
modes.definition_zh: 知识工程方法论/以图为主、以文为辅把口传手艺变成可复制的文件：百廿三幅工图各配简要说明，画的是设备结构、工序顺序与操作姿态——图纸不受方言之隔、不必师徒同场， distant 的工场可按图建设备、按序开工序；此法的洞见在于文本对工艺的天然不足：文字记'怎么做'啰嗦而含混，图直接呈现'长什么样、从哪到哪'——图文分工是工艺知识摆脱人身依附的接口标准
modes.definition_en: Knowledge-engineering methodology / turning oral craft into replicable documents with drawings as the lead and text as the support: one hundred and twenty-three diagrams, each with brief notes, depicting equipment structure, process sequence and operating posture — drawings cross dialect barriers, require no master present; a distant workshop can build the device from the drawing and run the process in order; the method's insight is the natural insufficiency of prose for craft: text describing 'how' is verbose and vague, the drawing directly shows 'what it looks like and where it goes' — the division of labour between picture and word is the interface standard by which craft knowledge escapes personal dependence
modes.key_quote_zh: 图而象之，书而识之……凡人强识而漫记者，十不能记一
modes.key_quote_en: 'Draw it as image, write it as note… what a man force-memorises and jotfully keeps, he cannot keep one part in ten.'
process_zh: 选择图示对象：凡有空间结构与顺序的工艺优先入图——设备剖面、工序流程、操作姿态
定图文分工：图负责形（结构、位置、方向），文负责数（尺寸、配比、时间）——图不写字、文不描形
按可重建标准绘制：拿到图的人不需现场指导即可照图制作设备或复演工序——以'远方能否照做'为绘图质量判准
配简注成套：每图附不超过百字的工序注，标明前后衔接——使成套图纸成为一条可执行的工艺链
process_en: Choose what to draw: any craft with spatial structure or sequence goes to the diagram first — equipment sections, process flows, operating postures
Fix the division: the drawing owns form (structure, position, direction), the text owns number (dimensions, ratios, durations) — no prose in the drawing, no shape-painting in the prose
Draw to a rebuild standard: one holding the drawing must reproduce the device or replay the process without on-site guidance — 'can it be done from afar' is the quality criterion of drawing
Bind with short notes: each drawing carries under a hundred words of process notes marking the joins before and after — making the set a single executable chain of craft
representative_cases_zh: 为水碓、筒车、织机、熔炉各绘结构图：轮轴位置、传动方向、部件比例一图可见——文字二十句不如图一幅
为提花织机绘'花机图'并注'花本'挑制工序——把最复杂的纺织机械写成可异地照建的图纸
为《甘嗜》绘糖车图：牛力传动结构与其部件尺寸标注——使产糖区之外亦可复制设备
序言自陈绘图缘起：'珍贵之图'与前人'凭空撰图'相对立——图必须来自亲见而非想象
representative_cases_en: Structural drawings for the water-power trip-hammer, chain pump, loom and smelting furnace: wheel-and-axle placement, transmission direction, part proportions visible at a glance — twenty sentences of prose beaten by one picture
The pattern-loom drawn with notes on 'pattern-card' cutting — the most complex textile machine written as a buildable drawing for a distant workshop
The sugar-mill drawn with ox-drive structure and part dimensions — letting equipment be copied beyond sugar districts
The preface states the drawing principle: his 'precious diagrams' stand against predecessors' 'drawings composed from imagination' — the figure must come from sight, not fancy
modern_applications_zh: 设备 SOP 以图为主的编制规范：装配图+关键步骤照片+简注，文字只记参数
远程运维知识库：以结构图与工序图为主干，跨语言团队照图作业
开源硬件文档：图纸的'远方可重建'判准——拿到图能否造出来是文档质量的硬指标
知识管理反人身依附：关键工艺必须有图示化备份，防'人走艺失'
modern_applications_en: SOP authoring with the drawing first: assembly diagrams + key-step photos + short notes; prose only for parameters
Remote-operations knowledge bases: structure and process drawings as the backbone, cross-language teams working from pictures
Open-hardware documentation: the 'rebuildable from afar' criterion — can someone build it from the drawing is the hard test of doc quality
Anti-dependence knowledge management: critical processes must have diagrammatic backups against 'the man leaves, the craft leaves'
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
《考工记》作者（先例：以文记工的最早系统尝试，但无图——宋应星补上图这一维）
达·芬奇（跨文明平行：工程手稿以图传意——同为图文分工的工艺记录者，但宋应星面向产业大众而非私人手稿）
鲁班一系匠作传统（对照：口诀与师徒制的传承方式，宋应星以图纸使其'反人身依附'）

modes.name_en: The Method of Heaven's Timing and Earth's Advantage
modes.domain_zh: 农时与地宜方法论/任何生产决策都置于'天时'（节气、气候窗口）与'地利'（水土、物产的区域禀赋）的双重约束下求解
modes.definition_zh: 农时与地宜方法论/任何生产决策都置于'天时'（节气、气候窗口）与'地利'（水土、物产的区域禀赋）的双重约束下求解：同一作物因南北而异其种法，同一工艺因水质炭质而异其成品——先问'此地此时什么长得最好'，再问'如何把此地此时之长转化为产出'，而不是拿一套标准做法硬套；此法把'因地制宜'从格言升级为求解流程：先绘约束地图，再在约束内优化
modes.definition_en: Agro-ecological methodology / solving every production decision under the double constraints of Heaven's timing (seasons, climatic windows) and Earth's advantage (water, soil, regional endowment): the same crop is grown differently north and south, the same process yields differently with different water and charcoal — first ask 'what grows best here and now', then 'how to convert this here-and-now advantage into output', rather than forcing one standard practice everywhere; the method upgrades 'adapt to local conditions' from motto to solving procedure: map the constraints first, optimise within them second
modes.key_quote_zh: 土脉历时代而异，种性随水土而分
modes.key_quote_en: 'Soil pulses differ across the ages, and seed-nature divides according to water and land.'
process_zh: 绘制约束地图：把生产要素的区域差异铺开——水土、气候、原料、劳力——标出'此地所长'与'此地所短'
识别时令窗口：列出时序敏感操作及其时间窗——浸种、插秧、养蚕、烧窑——错过窗口的代价显式标价
在约束内求解：以'此地所长'为设计起点选择作物与工艺，短处用贸易或替代品补——不与禀赋硬对抗
记录失败对照：凡硬套外地做法而失败的案例照录——约束地图因失败案例而越绘越准
process_en: Map the constraints: spread out the regional differences of production factors — water, soil, climate, materials, labour — marking what this place has and lacks
Identify the timing windows: list time-sensitive operations and their windows — seed-soaking, transplanting, silkworm raising, kiln firing — pricing explicitly the cost of missing each
Solve within constraints: take 'what this place has' as the design starting point for crops and processes, supply the lacks by trade or substitutes — never fight the endowment head-on
Record failure contrasts: cases of forcing imported practice and failing are entered as they occur — the constraint map sharpens with each recorded failure
representative_cases_zh: 写稻作：'南方平原，田多一岁两栽两获'与北方旱地的差异——同一作物的两套农时方案并列
写养蚕：蚕性喜温湿，'嘉兴湖州'与川闽之地养法各异——把区域禀赋写进工序差异
写陶瓷：'凡白土皆曰垩'，各地土性不同则窑法不同——原料禀赋决定工艺路线
写《乃粒》水利：'用水之说'按泉、江、湖、井分门——水源类型决定灌溉器具的选择
representative_cases_en: On rice: 'southern plains, two sowings and two harvests a year' against northern dryland practice — two agri-calendar schemes for one crop set side by side
On sericulture: the silkworm loves warmth and humidity, and Jiaxing-Huzhou methods differ from Sichuan-Fujian ones — regional endowment written into process difference
On porcelain: 'all white earth is called e', but each locality's earth demands its own kiln practice — raw-material endowment decides the process route
On water works in the grains chapter: irrigation doctrine classed by spring, river, lake and well — the water-source type decides the lifting device
modern_applications_zh: 选址与产区决策：以禀赋地图为起点而非以先例城市为模板
农业保险与农时窗口定价：把'错过窗口的代价'显式化后设计保险产品
分布式制造布局：按原料与能源禀赋落位工序——'工艺跟着禀赋走'
跨区域复制项目前的约束尽调：先绘当地约束地图再决定复制什么
modern_applications_en: Site and region decisions: start from the endowment map, not a template city
Agri-insurance and window pricing: making 'the cost of missing the window' explicit, then designing products on it
Distributed manufacturing siting: place processes by material and energy endowment — 'the process follows the endowment'
Constraint diligence before cross-region replication: map local constraints before deciding what to copy
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
贾思勰（先例：《齐民要术》'顺天时，量地利，则用力少而成功多'——农时地利的最早系统论述）
徐光启（平行：《农政全书》水利荒政的地宜分析，同为约束内求解）
冯·杜能（跨文明平行：农业区位论——区域禀赋与运输成本决定农作布局的理论化）

modes.name_en: The Method of Outliving through the Ledger
modes.domain_zh: 文献与存续方法论/以'功名毫不相关'的产业记录获得超越朝代的存续
modes.definition_zh: 文献与存续方法论/以'功名毫不相关'的产业记录获得超越朝代的存续：政治功业随王朝覆灭而湮灭，而记录了一个社会如何吃穿住行的账目型文献反而永生——宋应星五试不第后的转向，客观上把著述从'经术叙事'改写为'产业总账'，使一部技术书的寿命长于它记录的帝国；此法的要点是识别文献的两种生命力：依附权力的短命叙事与依附生存需求的长命记录
modes.definition_en: Philology-of-survival methodology / gaining permanence beyond dynasties through industrial records 'having nothing to do with official fame': political achievement perishes with the dynasty, while ledger-type documents recording how a society ate, dressed, dwelt and travelled live forever — Song Yingxing's turn after five examination failures objectively rewrote authorship from 'classical narrative' to 'industrial account', giving a technical book a longer life than the empire it recorded; the method's point is discerning two lifespans of texts: power-dependent short narrative and survival-dependent long record
modes.key_quote_zh: 此书于功名进取毫不相关也
modes.key_quote_en: 'This book has nothing to do with the pursuit of official advancement.'
process_zh: 识别两种写作：写出你笔下内容的依附对象——权力（会换代）还是生存需求（不变）
选择长命轴：把知识落在人类持续的需求轴上——吃、穿、住、行、医——远离纯粹的权力叙事
以账目形态写作：数字、配比、工序、价格——账目比颂词难被篡改，也比颂词更久被需要
接受现世回报的延迟：账目型写作在当世可能寂寂无名——判准是五十年后是否仍被查阅，而非当世是否被称颂
process_en: Discern the two writings: name what your content depends on — power (changes hands) or survival needs (unchanging)
Choose the long axis: ground knowledge in the continuing axis of human need — food, clothing, shelter, movement, medicine — away from pure power narrative
Write in ledger form: numbers, ratios, processes, prices — ledgers resist tampering better than panegyrics, and are needed longer
Accept delayed worldly reward: ledger-writing may go unsung in its day — the criterion is whether it is consulted in fifty years, not whether it is applauded now
representative_cases_zh: 五试不第后弃科举叙事，自序言明'此书于功名进取毫不相关'——把著述合法性从功名转到民生
全书以工序与数字为骨架，几乎不做道德议论——使此书在清代仍被匠人与后来的技术史家持续查阅
《野议》论时政用粮价、盐利等实数——政论也写成账目，使批评免于空疏
对照：同代不少颂圣文字随朝代湮灭，而《天工开物》东传日本朝鲜被翻刻引用——长命记录的实证
representative_cases_en: After five failures he abandoned examination-narrative, declaring in the preface 'this book has nothing to do with official advancement' — moving the legitimacy of writing from rank to livelihood
The book's skeleton is process and number, almost without moral commentary — so that in the Qing it was still consulted by craftsmen and later historians of technology
The Essays on the Times argues policy with real figures of grain prices and salt revenue — even polemic written as account, sparing criticism from emptiness
The contrast: contemporaries' panegyrics perished with the dynasty, while the Tiangong Kaiwu travelled to Japan and Korea for reprint and citation — the empirics of a long-lived record
modern_applications_zh: 技术文档写作的'账目优先'：记录可复现的事实与参数，少写立场修辞
组织知识资产规划：把最有长期价值的知识做成'总账型'文档——脱离人事与政潮
个人职业写作：作品价值判准设为'十年后是否仍被引用'
危机期知识保存：把社会运作的关键账目（供应链、能源、医疗）作为最高优先级文档
modern_applications_en: 'Ledger-first' technical writing: record reproducible facts and parameters, go easy on positional rhetoric
Organisational knowledge-asset planning: make the most durably valuable knowledge 'ledger-type' documents — detached from personnel and political weather
Career writing: set the value criterion at 'still cited in ten years?'
Crisis-period knowledge preservation: key accounts of social operation (supply, energy, health) as the highest-priority documents
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
司马迁（先例：'究天人之际'的著述以传世自任——但以史传为体，宋应星以产业账目为体）
沈括（平行：《梦溪笔谈》博杂存真，同为非功名导向的知识存录）
索珀（跨文明平行：李约瑟《中国的科学与文明》正是以《天工开物》为支柱——账目传世的现代见证人）

modes.name_en: The Method of Engineering the Investigation of Things
modes.domain_zh: 认识论总纲/把儒家'格物致知'从道德修养与科举玄谈改写为工程实践
modes.definition_zh: 认识论总纲/把儒家'格物致知'从道德修养与科举玄谈改写为工程实践：格物不是静坐冥想万物之理，而是动手把物做成——格竹不成则种竹、格水不成则治水；知识生于'做成一件东西'的完整回路：观察物性→设计工序→动手制作→以成品与账目结算认知；此法综合了前九法的全部要素（天工人力、采访核账、火候物性、链条、图纸、账目），是宋应星知识论的总收束：真知=能做成的知识
modes.definition_en: The epistemological synthesis / rewriting the Confucian 'investigation of things' (gewu zhizhi) from moral cultivation and examination-hall speculation into engineering practice: to investigate bamboo is not to meditate on it but to grow it, to investigate water not to contemplate it but to channel it; knowledge is born of the complete circuit of making a thing — observe the material's nature, design the process, work with the hands, settle the cognition against product and account; the method gathers all nine foregoing methods (Heaven-man division, field inquiry and ledger, heat-timing, chains, drawings, accounts) into Song Yingxing's closing epistemology: true knowledge is knowledge that can be made to work
modes.key_quote_zh: 此书于功名进取毫不相关也……贵五谷而贱金玉（序）——格物之实，在厂在田，不在场屋
modes.key_quote_en: 'This book has nothing to do with official advancement… honour the grains and deem gold and jade cheap (preface) — the substance of investigating things lies in workshop and field, not in the examination hall.'
process_zh: 把命题转为制品：任何'知'的要求都问'它对应什么可做成的东西'——无制品对应的命题降格为假设
设计完整回路：观察物性→设计工序→动手制作→结算账目——四段缺一不可，跳过制作即跳过认知
以成品结算认知：做成了且账对得上才算'格'过——做成但账不平说明认知有漏，账平但做不成说明认知是空转
把成品回写知识库：每件成品附工序、配比与失败记录——使认知沉淀为可复制的组织记忆
process_en: Convert propositions into artefacts: of every claim to knowledge ask 'what thing, when made, does it correspond to' — propositions without an artefact demote to hypothesis
Design the complete circuit: observe nature → design process → make with the hands → settle the account — all four stages; skip the making and you skip the knowing
Settle cognition on the product: 'investigated' means made and reconciled; made but unreconciled means cognition leaks; reconciled but unmakeable means cognition idles
Write artefacts back into the base: each finished piece carries process, ratios and failure records — cognition sedimenting into replicable organisational memory
representative_cases_zh: 全书即此法的展开：每一物（稻、蚕、砖、船、墨）都走完'物性-工序-制作-工价'四段——格物成为可查账的作业
自序将'俗儒臆说'与'匠人实录'对立——认识论的敌我划分以'是否做过'为准
《论气》以声、气的可观察现象为格物对象——连自然哲学也守住'可验'底线
科举五败不怨天，转以著书立'格物别传'——把个人挫折转化为认识论路线的分岔
representative_cases_en: The whole book unfolds this method: for each thing (rice, silkworm, brick, ship, ink) the four stages — nature, process, making, price — are completed; investigation becomes auditable work
The preface sets 'pedants' conjecture' against 'craftsmen's record' — the epistemic friend-enemy line drawn at 'has he done it'
The Essays on Qi investigates sound and qi through observable phenomena — even natural philosophy holds the 'verifiable' line
Five examination failures, no complaints — instead a book written as an 'alternative biography of investigation', turning personal setback into an epistemological fork
modern_applications_zh: 工程团队的'能做成的知识'判准：方案不落地成制品不算验证完成
实验科学的'完整回路'要求：观察-设计-制作-结算缺一环即未完成一次格物
教育改革：以做成为考试——把'知道'的判准改写为'能做成'
知识库的组织化沉淀：成品必附工序与失败记录——组织认知的复利积累
modern_applications_en: The engineering team's criterion: knowledge that cannot be made into an artefact is not yet verified
The complete circuit in experimental science: observe-design-make-settle; missing any one stage, no investigation has occurred
Educational reform: examine by making — rewrite the criterion of 'knowing' into 'can make'
Organisational sedimentation in knowledge bases: every artefact carries process and failure records — compound accumulation of collective cognition
representative_figures: 宋应星（核心）
王阳明（对照：'格竹'七日而病——格物冥想路线的失败案例，恰为宋应星工程化路线立起反面靶）
徐光启（平行：《农政全书》同样以'垦田用水做成事'为知识判准——明末实学的双路线）
李约瑟（跨文明平行：以'做成与记载'重估中国科学——正是格物工程化路线的现代史家）
